# RoyaleGym

> Make a Clash Royale bot in Python. Five packages: RoyaleSim (a deterministic battle engine in
> Rust with Python bindings), RoyaleGym (Gymnasium and PettingZoo environments: observations,
> actions with a legality mask, rewards), RoyaleLearn (a PPO self-play trainer), RoyaleViser (a
> viewer for saved or live battles) and RoyaleImitate (imitation from replays). Install all with
> `pip install "royalegym[all]"` (Python 3.12+). The engine's battle logic is still being matched
> to the real game; the Python APIs are meant to stay put.

Each repository also has an AGENTS.md at its root with its layout, build and test commands, and
the rules its tests enforce.

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](index.md): what the five packages are and how they fit
- [Install](install.md): the one install line, the extras, a virtual environment
- [Quick Start](quick-start.md): one file that trains a bot and saves a battle to watch
- [Watch Your Bot](watch-your-bot.md): open a saved battle or a live training run

## Guides

- [Rewards](guides/rewards.md): write a reward, combine rewards, read the per-term breakdown
- [Observations and Actions](guides/observations-and-actions.md): the observation dict, the 2305 moves, the mask, ability buttons
- [Custom Decks](guides/custom-decks.md): decks by name, one per side, evolutions and heroes
